page.layout: One column of text, with Hebrew headwords set at the left margin of each entry. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: tur, Job.34.20. Hithp. [?]והתנעשו Et commoventur, Jer.25. v.16. cum Cholem in medio, propter ejectum Dagesch, ut in Pyhal. Sic Futur. יתנעשו Commoveantur, Jerem.46.8. Et cum Pathach, יתנעשו Jer.46.7.

נֶפֶשׁ גּוּף m. Corpus: Ala: Cum Aff. בנפשו Cum corpore suo, Exod. 21.3. i.e. בלחודוהי ut Targum reddit: nempe, Non etiam cum uxore. Plur.Constr. על נפי Super alis, id est, pinnis excelsis, Prov.9.3. Quidam, Super eminentiis: quasi pro נפי, de quo in גבב. Chald. Idem: Plural. נפין Ala, Dan.7.v.4. Aff. נפיה Alæ ejus, ibid. אנפין Vide in א: Item בגפו Vide supra in גוף.
גֶּפֶן f. Vitis, Gen.40.9. Semel masculinum est, בוקק Vitis vacuans, Hos.10.1. Aff. גפנו Vitem suam, id est, Fructum vitis suæ, 2.Reg.18.31. & sic Jerem.5.17. Plural. והגפנים Et vites, Cant.2.13.
גֹּפֶר m. Gopher, Cedri species, Gen.6.14. Plinius lib.13. cap.5. meminit cujusdam, quæ cariem non sentit, cuiq; materia est æternitas.
גָּרָב masc. Psora; scabies maligna, intus & foris sicca, juxta R.Sal. Levit.21.20. Deut.28.25.
גָּרַד Hithp. התגרד Scabere, Scalpere se: Infinit. להתגרד Ad scabendum se, Job.2.8.

גָּרָה Pih. Miscere; & de Contentione ac Bello tantùm dicitur, quomodo Virgilius dixit, Miscere prælia; & Cicero, Miscere & concitare certamina. Futur. יגרה מדון Miscet contentionem, Proverb. 29.22. Hithp. Præterit. התגרית Miscuisti, scil. bellum, Jerem.50.v.24. Imperat. והתגר בו מלחמה Et misce cum eo bellum, Deut.2.24. per Apocopam.
תִּגְרָה f. Conflictus: Constr. מתגרת ידך A conflictu manus tua, Psal.39.11.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are mostly omitted; the Hebrew forms are copied from the consonants visible on the scan. Hithp. והתנעשו at the top, and the headword גפר, are doubtful and not fully legible at this resolution; [?] is placed on the first. Running head and catchword are Hebrew and copied as seen. The "A conflictu" and "manus tua" readings are slightly uncertain. A faint digitiser watermark at the bottom right was left out.
